skim: A government ferry capsized on Zimbabwe’s Lake Kariba, killing at least 44 after carrying nearly double its rated capacity; President Mnangagwa declared a state of disaster.
Colombia’s earthquake death toll climbed past 180 as rescuers raced the closing search window in Cali and Pereira.
Trump claimed “total control” of the Strait of Hormuz, but Iran insists it stays shut until its conditions are met, with vessel transits down to single digits a day.
Tata Sons chairman N. Chandrasekaran will step down in February 2027 after his reappointment bid failed to win unanimous board backing.
Cisco posted record $17.3 billion quarterly revenue as AI infrastructure orders surged 4.5x, guiding FY27 revenue toward $73 billion.

stories.headline: Overloaded Ferry Capsizes on Zimbabwe's Lake Kariba, Killing at Least 44
stories.body: A government-operated ferry capsized on Lake Kariba on Tuesday, killing at least 44 people; the vessel was carrying an estimated 153 passengers despite a rated capacity of 90, with 77 rescued, per AP/KSAT (Aug 12). Survivors said they begged the captain to turn back as waves grew dangerous, with one crew member recalling “passengers were screaming at us that the boat was flooding, water was pouring into the engine room”; President Mnangagwa declared a state of disaster.

stories.headline: Colombia Earthquake Toll Climbs Past 180 as Rescuers Race Against Time
stories.body: Colombia's 7.4-magnitude earthquake has killed at least 181 people and injured over 2,500, with rescue teams working through the critical 48-72 hour window in the hardest-hit cities of Cali, Pereira, Manizales and Quibdo, per NPR (Aug 12). The US pledged over $15 million in relief and Mexico prepared to send hundreds of relief workers and supplies as the search continues.

stories.headline: Philippines Flood Death Toll Rises to 21, Over 3.1 Million Affected
stories.body: The death toll from the southwest monsoon and tropical cyclones Luis and Maymay has climbed to 21, with more than 3.1 million Filipinos affected across 10 regions, per Manila Bulletin (Aug 12), citing the Office of Civil Defense. Officials said “15 of the fatalities were recorded in the Cordillera Administrative Region while six were reported in Calabarzon”, with infrastructure damage reaching ₱2.109 billion.

stories.headline: Typhoon Dolphin Sets Rainfall Records, Floods Spread to Beijing
stories.body: Typhoon Dolphin, described as China's strongest typhoon this year, battered Beijing with intense rain that flooded major roads and stranded vehicles while setting new rainfall records across central and eastern provinces, per Geo News (Aug 12). The capital issued its second-highest rainstorm warning, suspending 250 bus routes and closing 150 tourist attractions, with one resident saying “the most troublesome part is that it affects work and life” as the storm threatens more flooding across northern and central China.

stories.headline: Rodri-Barcelona Transfer Down to the Wire Over Fee Gap
stories.body: Barcelona and Manchester City remain apart on Rodri's fee, with Barca's revised offer sitting around €60-65m against City's roughly €80m valuation, per Yahoo Sports (Aug 12). The next 48 hours are seen as critical, with a failure to agree risking Rodri's return to Man City training.

stories.headline: Trent Rockets Confirmed in Both Hundred Finals as Eliminators Set
stories.body: Trent Rockets topped both the men's and women's group tables to secure direct final berths at Lord's on Sunday, per Sky Sports (Aug 12). Manchester Super Giants face SunRisers Leeds in Friday's men's eliminator, while Southern Brave meet SunRisers Leeds in the women's eliminator.

stories.headline: Hamilton Gives Modest Self-Assessment Despite Strong 2026 Form
stories.body: Lewis Hamilton rated his first half of the 2026 season “slightly above average, maybe” despite delivering Ferrari's maiden win of the year in Barcelona and five podiums without a retirement, per Motorsport Week (Aug 12). He said he is “thinking about just one race at a time” as F1 prepares to resume from its summer break.

stories.headline: Sri Lanka Name Squad for Series-Opening Test Against India
stories.body: Sri Lanka have named Dhananjaya de Silva as captain, with Kamindu Mendis his deputy, for the Galle Test starting Aug 15, per India TV News (Aug 12). The squad leans on spin pair Prabath Jayasuriya and Ramesh Mendis alongside four seamers, blending veteran Dinesh Chandimal with emerging talent.

stories.headline: July CPI Holds at 3.4%, Matching Forecasts as Fed Rate-Cut Odds Stay in Flux
stories.body: Headline inflation came in at 3.4% year-over-year with a 0.1% monthly rise, both in line with estimates, while core CPI held at 2.5% annually (Aug 12). Treasury yields were little changed on the in-line print, and market-implied odds of a September Fed rate move sat near 44-50%, caught between above-target inflation and a surprisingly weak July jobs report.

stories.headline: Brent Crude Nears $90 as Hormuz Shipping Attacks Dim Reopening Hopes
stories.body: Brent crude rose more than 2% to close in on $90 a barrel after fresh Middle East shipping attacks undercut optimism over reopening the Strait of Hormuz, per Al Jazeera (Aug 12). Analysts said “confidence is clearly eroding” amid stalled talks, with the strait — once carrying roughly a fifth of global oil supply — now seeing only about 10 vessel transits a day versus 130 before the standoff.

stories.headline: Gold Holds Above $4,400 as Traders Digest CPI Data
stories.body: Gold futures opened at $4,430 on Aug 12 before rallying to $4,470 by mid-morning, with the softer July jobs report and CPI expectations keeping prices “holding well above $4,400,” per Yahoo Finance (Aug 12). Traders had been pricing roughly 50-50 odds of a September rate move heading into the inflation data.

stories.headline: Cisco Posts Record $17.3B Quarter as AI Orders Surge 4.5x
stories.body: Cisco closed fiscal 2026 with record fourth-quarter revenue of $17.3 billion (up 18% year-over-year) and non-GAAP EPS of $1.22 (up 23%), beating estimates, per BigGo Finance (Aug 12). AI infrastructure orders hit $9.3 billion for the year — about 4.5 times prior-year levels — and the company guided FY27 revenue to $72.2-$73.4 billion, with CEO Chuck Robbins citing an “agentic AI”-driven “networking super cycle.”

stories.headline: Google's Gemini App Surpasses 1 Billion Monthly Active Users
stories.body: CEO Sundar Pichai announced Gemini has become one of Google's fastest-growing products ever, crossing 1 billion monthly active users and becoming the 14th Google product to hit that mark, per TechCrunch (Aug 11). The app now generates over 150 million images daily and 63% of users interact with it via voice, putting it in close competition with ChatGPT, which passed 1 billion users in June.

stories.headline: Nvidia's $500B Financing Plan Faces New Risk From Chinese Chip Flood
stories.body: A day after Nvidia unveiled its Wall Street-backed $500 billion AI compute financing platform with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR, analysts flagged a fresh threat, per Tech Times (Aug 12): Huawei's Ascend 950PR chip entered mass production in April and could push Nvidia's China market share from roughly 40% down to 8% by year-end. Analysts warn a flood of cheaper Chinese silicon onto the secondary GPU market could erode collateral values underpinning the financing deal faster than loan terms anticipate.

stories.headline: IBM and Together AI Ink $240 Million Nvidia-Powered Inference Cluster Deal
stories.body: IBM and Together AI signed a multiyear, $240 million agreement to build a large-scale AI inference cluster on IBM Cloud, per BNN Bloomberg (Aug 11). The initial buildout will include roughly 2,000 Nvidia Blackwell 300 chips using HGX B300 systems and Spectrum-X Ethernet networking, aimed at enterprise deployment of open-source AI models.

stories.headline: Foxconn Q2 Profit Jumps 35% as AI Servers Overtake Consumer Electronics
stories.body: Taiwan's Foxconn (Hon Hai) reported a 35% year-on-year rise in second-quarter net profit to NT$59.97 billion ($1.86 billion), beating analyst forecasts, per Reuters/Yahoo Finance (Aug 12). Its cloud and networking division, which builds AI servers, accounted for 51% of quarterly revenue, surpassing consumer electronics (29%) for the first time.

stories.headline: Researchers Detail First Fully Autonomous AI Cyberattack on a Government Target
stories.body: Israeli cybersecurity firm Dream documented what it says is the first end-to-end autonomous AI hacking operation against a government, targeting Taiwan and suspected to be linked to China, per Security Affairs (Aug 12). Up to eight simultaneous AI agents mapped 21 government systems, adapted tactics on the fly, compromised at least 85 accounts and extracted over 2,500 personnel records within four days in early July.

stories.headline: Iran Disputes Trump's 'Total Control' Claim as Hormuz Traffic Craters
stories.body: President Trump claimed the US has achieved a “wall of steel” blockade and “total control” of the Strait of Hormuz, but Iran insists the waterway “remains blocked and will not be reopened until Iran's conditions are accepted,” per Gulf News (Aug 13). Transit fell to just 8 vessels on Tuesday versus a pre-war average of 130-140 ships daily, and US forces have now redirected 59 commercial vessels, disabled 3, and boarded 2 more, per Al Jazeera (Aug 12).

stories.headline: Zaporizhzhia Declares Day of Mourning After Deadly Russian Strike
stories.body: A Russian drone and missile barrage on Zaporizhzhia overnight killed 7 people and injured 24, prompting regional authorities to declare Aug 12 a day of mourning, per Ukrinform (Aug 11). The strike caused widespread building damage, fires and power outages, and follows Zelenskyy's accusation that Russia used North Korean missiles in the attack.

stories.headline: Sudan's Civil Alliance Rebuffs al-Burhan's National Dialogue Push
stories.body: Sudan's Somoud civil alliance is pushing back on army chief Abdel Fattah al-Burhan's proposed internal dialogue, viewing it as a bid by the ruling military to “seek political legitimacy from civil forces,” per Sudan Tribune (Aug 10). The alliance instead plans to press ahead with its own Nairobi Declaration conference in late October and remains opposed to including the National Congress Party or Rapid Support Forces in any future governance structure.

stories.headline: Syrian Court's Death Sentence for Assad Draws Mixed Reaction
stories.body: Syria's Fourth Criminal Court formally sentenced former president Bashar al-Assad, his brother Maher, and cousin Atef Najib to death in absentia for premeditated murder, torture, and crimes against humanity tied to the 2011 Deraa crackdown, per Al Jazeera (Aug 11). The presiding judge said Assad was the “highest decision-maker” who used state institutions to facilitate the crimes, a ruling many Syrians have hailed as “justice at last.”

fixtures.headline: India's Tour of Sri Lanka Begins in Galle
fixtures.body: Shubman Gill's India open the two-match Test series against Dhananjaya de Silva's Sri Lanka, with the second Test to follow in Colombo.

fixtures.headline: The Hundred Finals Day at Lord's
fixtures.body: Trent Rockets, already through in both the men's and women's competitions, face the winners of Friday's eliminators for the titles.

fixtures.headline: F1 Returns From Summer Break at the Dutch Grand Prix
fixtures.body: The championship resumes at Zandvoort, with Red Bull looking to end its winless run and Ferrari aiming to build on Hamilton's Barcelona victory.

fixtures.headline: Premier League 2026-27 Season Begins
fixtures.body: The new season's opening match round kicks off Friday, Aug 21 — a week later than usual to give players extra recovery time after the 2026 World Cup.

portfolio.headline: Meta Opens $1.4 Trillion Children's-Data Trial, Faces Glasses Privacy Complaint
portfolio.body: A coalition of 29 U.S. states began a landmark trial accusing Meta of improperly collecting and using children's data, with four additional states pursuing broader claims about addictive platform design; potential remedies include restrictions on infinite scrolling and changes to recommendation algorithms, a more structural risk than a fine. CEO Mark Zuckerberg and Instagram head Adam Mosseri are expected to testify over the trial's seven-week run. Separately, German digital-rights group HateAid filed a criminal complaint alleging privacy violations tied to Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses, per coverage (Aug 12).

portfolio.headline: Nvidia Customers CoreWeave, Super Micro Signal Accelerating AI Spending
portfolio.body: Two major AI-infrastructure customers pointed to strengthening demand for Nvidia chips: CoreWeave raised its capital-expenditure outlook after its order backlog swelled past $100 billion, and Super Micro lifted its fiscal 2027 revenue guidance on robust orders for AI server systems, per coverage (Aug 12). The updates reinforced expectations that AI-chip demand extends well beyond current quarterly forecasts.

portfolio.headline: Intel Prices Upsized $20 Billion Stock Offering to Fund AI Chip Push
portfolio.body: Intel priced an upsized common stock offering to raise $20 billion, with underwriters reportedly fielding roughly $100 billion in investor demand for the deal, per CNBC (Aug 10). The company said proceeds will fund expansion of its AI chip manufacturing capacity.

portfolio.headline: Uber Faces Cybersecurity Probe, Deepens Autonomous-Vehicle Bet
portfolio.body: Uber Freight is investigating a cybersecurity incident after hackers claimed unauthorized access to its systems, per coverage (Aug 12). Separately, Uber detailed plans to commit more than $10 billion toward autonomous-vehicle development and exited its stake in Serve Robotics amid a strategic split, while a California legal change could open the door to large-scale unionization among rideshare drivers.

portfolio.headline: Oracle Draws Interest as AI Optimism Squares Off Against Credit Concerns
portfolio.body: Investors weighed Oracle's artificial-intelligence growth opportunity against balance-sheet strain, including a July S&P credit-rating downgrade and roughly $260 billion in data-center lease commitments. No new company-specific announcement was identified for the session; the activity looks like positioning ahead of Oracle's September 8 earnings report rather than a fresh catalyst.

portfolio.headline: Twilio Draws Valuation Debate After Post-Earnings Surge
portfolio.body: Analysts have been debating whether Twilio's sharp post-earnings rerating has run ahead of fundamentals, with one widely cited valuation model arguing fair value sits meaningfully below the recent trading level even after accounting for improved revenue growth and margins. Analysts flagged rising carrier fees squeezing messaging margins and the risk that AI-driven customers adopt alternative platforms as key swing factors.

portfolio.headline: Rackspace Leans Further Into AI Infrastructure After Mixed Q2
portfolio.body: Rackspace reported second-quarter results showing roughly flat revenue and a wider net loss, but management emphasized its pivot toward enterprise AI, highlighting a new Managed Compute and Inference Platform built with AMD and backed by a Palantir partnership. CEO Gajen Kandiah said regulated-industry clients are moving AI workloads from experimentation into production.

portfolio.headline: Protalix Swings to Profit on Stronger Elfabrio Sales
portfolio.body: Protalix BioTherapeutics reported second-quarter net income that reversed a year-earlier loss, driven by higher Elfabrio sales to partners Chiesi and Fiocruz plus a $25 million milestone payment tied to EU dosage approval. The company also disclosed a five-year U.S. patent extension for Elfabrio through 2035 and reaffirmed full-year revenue guidance of $78-83 million.

stories.headline: Tata Sons Chairman N. Chandrasekaran to Step Down as Reappointment Bid Fails
stories.body: N. Chandrasekaran announced he will not seek reappointment as Tata Sons chairman when his term ends on February 20, 2027, after a proposed five-year extension failed to win unanimous board support — one board member withheld approval, per WION (Aug 12). Tata Group shares fell on the news, with attention turning to succession candidates including Noel Tata and his children.

stories.headline: Two Dead, Several Feared Trapped After Landslide Hits Mumbai's Kurla
stories.body: A rain-triggered landslide struck Gaushiya Chawl in Kurla's Chirag Nagar at around 3:48am, killing two people and injuring two teenage brothers who were hospitalised, per WION (Aug 12). NDRF, fire brigade and civic teams launched rescue operations, with a DCP saying “around 4-5 people are likely trapped.”

stories.headline: Kashmiri Pandit Government Employees Sent on Leave After Fresh Terror Threat
stories.body: Security agencies sent Kashmiri Pandit government employees on leave in the Valley, and shifted some to Jammu, after a purported threat communication naming community members surfaced, per Dynamite News (Aug 12). The move adds a sharper, community-specific edge to the broader security lockdown already in place across Jammu & Kashmir ahead of Independence Day.

stories.headline: 12-Hour Karnataka Bandh Called for Aug 13 Over Cauvery Water Release
stories.body: Pro-Kannada groups led by activist Vatal Nagaraj called a 12-hour bandh for August 13 to oppose releasing roughly 12,000 cusecs of Cauvery water to Tamil Nadu for an extra 15 days as ordered by the Cauvery Water Management Authority, and to press for progress on the Mekedatu, Mahadayi and Kalasa-Banduri projects, per WION (Aug 12).

stories.headline: Double Murderer and Serial Sex Attacker Simon Levy Given Whole Life Order
stories.body: Simon Levy, 40, was handed a whole life sentence at the Old Bailey for murdering Carmenza Valencia-Trujillo, 53, in March 2025 and Sheryl Wilkins, 39, in August 2025, both suffocated in sexually motivated attacks, plus raping a third woman, per ITV News (Aug 12). The judge said Levy “ruthlessly exploits others for your own personal sexual satisfaction.”

stories.headline: PM Burnham to Chair Emergency COBRA Meeting as Wildfires and Extreme Heat Mount
stories.body: With 966 wildfires already recorded across England and Wales this year (July the busiest month on record at 458), the Met Office issued a rare amber extreme-heat warning for temperatures up to 38°C, prompting PM Andy Burnham to chair an emergency Cobra meeting and urge shops to stop selling disposable barbecues, per ITV News (Aug 12). Burnham said the government would “continue to take the action needed to keep communities safe, protect water supplies and safeguard the environment.”

stories.headline: Households Near New Pylons to Get Up to £2,500 Off Bills
stories.body: The government named 43 new pylon and grid infrastructure projects qualifying for a bills-discount scheme, offering households within 500 metres up to £2,500 off electricity bills over 10 years starting in the first half of 2027, per ITV News (Aug 12). More than 100,000 households could eventually benefit as further projects are approved.

stories.headline: UK's Best Solar Eclipse Since 1999 Dazzles Skygazers
stories.body: The partial eclipse Britain had been bracing for delivered, with over 90% of the sun obscured across the UK between 6:17pm and 8:06pm and Cornwall and the Channel Islands seeing peak coverage of 94-96%, per ITV News (Aug 12). Thousands turned out at viewing sites nationwide as Iceland saw a rare total eclipse and Spain its first in over a century.

stories.headline: Qatar: Oman-Iran Talks on Reopening Strait of Hormuz Reach 'Important Stage'
stories.body: Qatar's foreign ministry spokesperson Dr Majed bin Mohammed Al Ansari said Oman-Iran negotiations have reached “a critical point,” with talks entering a technical stage and Iran preparing an official announcement, per The Peninsula Qatar (Aug 12). He said Doha's priority remains reopening the Strait while preserving the ceasefire and supporting regional negotiations.

stories.headline: Kuwait Foils Terror Plot Targeting Vital Facility
stories.body: Kuwait's State Security Service arrested a Kuwaiti citizen trained in manufacturing explosives and drones who had built a drone “with the intention of using it to carry out his terrorist plot and target a vital facility,” per The Peninsula Qatar (Aug 12). The interior ministry said security measures would continue to detect and counter threats to the country's security.

stories.headline: Qatar Accuses Israel of 'Foot-Dragging' on Gaza Peace Plan
stories.body: Qatar's foreign ministry spokesperson said Israel's rejection of the Gaza peace plan represents “a continuation of its foot-dragging in implementing the agreements” reached for a ceasefire, per The Peninsula Qatar (Aug 11). He said Hamas's recent declaration had produced a breakthrough, meaning “the responsibility right now lies on the Israeli side to live up to its obligations.”

doha_events.headline: Children of India Mark Independence Day at Planet Scribbles
doha_events.body: A two-hour interactive celebration with DIY activities and Indian cultural learning runs August 13-15 from 9am at Planet Scribbles Store, Barwa Village; entry QAR 50, per Qatar Living.

doha_events.headline: Soul Elegance Wellness Day at Qatar Museums
doha_events.body: Qatar Museums hosts a full-day event on August 15 (12pm-6pm) with the Qatari Women's Association, featuring creativity and wellness workshops plus a traditional hospitality-themed lunch; registration required, per The Peninsula Qatar.

doha_events.headline: Hala Summer Shopping Festival Continues at Doha Festival City
doha_events.body: The month-long shopping and dining activation runs through August with raffle draws for prizes including five cars, with festival activity noted for August 14 at Doha Festival City, per The Peninsula Qatar.

doha_events.headline: Drawtastic Art Session at Mathaf's Manara Art Studio
doha_events.body: An open-medium drawing session with a live model takes place August 15 from 4pm-6pm at Mathaf's Manara Art Studio, giving participants freedom to create in any style, per The Peninsula Qatar.

doha_events.headline: Liwan X M7 Kid's Summer Camp Runs Through August 20
doha_events.body: A creative summer program covering design, ceramics, recycling, photography and clothing design continues August 9-20, 10am-1pm, at M7 and Liwan; QAR 500, per Qatar Living.
